title: Verify Ignition tag provider mapping for OptiSweep communication (SYS1 → tags → AvevaTest)
summary: Verify that the Ignition tag provider mapping contains the expected station/hospital tag namespaces (GLDStation* and Hospital1, plus TipperStation* entries with the documented suffix naming) and that SYS1’s metric-to-tag conversion is reflected by the presence of the tags AvevaTest is expected to read.
when_to_use: Use when you need to confirm that OptiSweep communication is using the documented Ignition tag provider mapping and that SYS1 metrics are converted into tags that AvevaTest reads.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for deeper tag provider/mapping configuration troubleshooting if the expected mapped tag namespaces are missing; escalate to the appropriate tag provider/mapping configuration support procedure.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Perform the live Ignition tag tree/tag browser checks for the expected GLDStation*, Hospital1, and TipperStation* namespaces and confirm whether the SYS1 → tags → AvevaTest mapping concept is reflected by tag presence.
access_or_tools_needed: Ability to view tag names/namespaces such as GLDStation1a/1b, GLDStation2a/2b, Hospital1, and TipperStation*

visual_references.description: Ignition tag tree/tag provider mapping slide showing expected namespaces (GLDStation*, Hospital1, TipperStation* with suffix naming) and the SYS1 → tags → AvevaTest concept.

steps.title: Open the Ignition tag browser/tree and locate the expected station/hospital tag namespaces
steps.purpose: Establish whether the Ignition tag provider mapping contains the expected station/hospital namespaces that the source indicates are mapped under Ignition.
steps.instruction: In the Ignition tag browser/tree, locate the tag namespace entries shown in the source for station/hospital mapping, including GLDStation* entries (e.g., GLDStation1a/GLDStation1b and GLDStation2a/GLDStation2b), Hospital1, and TipperStation* entries with the documented suffix naming (e.g., 1a/1b, 2a/2b, etc.).
steps.expected_result: The Ignition tag tree contains the mapped station/hospital tag namespaces shown in the source (GLDStation* and Hospital1, plus TipperStation* entries with the documented suffix naming).
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the expected GLDStation* namespaces, Hospital1, and multiple TipperStation* namespaces in the Ignition tag tree.
steps.failure_condition: One or more expected mapped namespaces (GLDStation1b / GLDStation2a / GLDStation2b / Hospital1 / TipperStation* nodes) are not present in the Ignition tag tree where they are expected to be mapped.

actions.label: Locate GLDStation*, Hospital1, and TipperStation* nodes in Ignition tag tree
actions.exact_action: Use the Ignition tag browser/tree to find the tag names/namespaces listed in the source (GLDStation1a/1b, GLDStation2a/2b, Hospital1, and TipperStation* with suffixes like 1a/1b, 2a/2b, etc.).

stop_or_escalate_if: Expected mapped tag namespaces from the source (e.g., GLDStation1b / GLDStation2a / GLDStation2b / Hospital1 / TipperStation* nodes) are not present in the Ignition tag tree where they should be mapped.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Slide text shows: "All tippers and Hospitals tags are ... GLDStation1b mapped in Ignition" and "For OptiSweep to communicate we utilize tag provider and are mapped under Ignition" and lists "Hospital1" and multiple "TipperStation*" entries with suffixes (e.g., TipperStation1a/1b, TipperStation2a/2b, ...).

steps.title: Confirm SYS1 metric-to-tag conversion is reflected by the presence of AvevaTest-readable tags
steps.purpose: Validate the SYS1 → tags → AvevaTest mapping concept by checking that the tags AvevaTest is expected to read exist under the Ignition mapping.
steps.instruction: Using the Ignition tag browser/tree, verify that the tags implied by the SYS1 → tags → AvevaTest concept are present under the mapped station/hospital namespaces (GLDStation* / Hospital1 / TipperStation*). Treat the presence of these tags as evidence that SYS1’s metrics are being converted into tags AvevaTest can read.
steps.expected_result: The SYS1→tags→AvevaTest mapping concept is reflected by the presence of the tags AvevaTest is expected to read under the Ignition mapping.
steps.healthy_condition: Within the Ignition tag tree, the expected station/hospital namespaces and their corresponding TipperStation* / GLDStation* / Hospital1 tag entries exist (i.e., the tags that AvevaTest would read are present).
steps.failure_condition: The expected mapped tag nodes (station/hospital namespaces and the SYS1→tags→AvevaTest mapping concept) are missing or not present where the source indicates they should be mapped.

actions.label: Check for SYS1→tags→AvevaTest tag presence under mapped namespaces
actions.exact_action: Confirm that the tag entries listed in the source under the Ignition mapping (GLDStation* / Hospital1 / TipperStation* with suffix naming) exist in the Ignition tag tree.

stop_or_escalate_if: Expected mapped tag namespaces from the source (e.g., GLDStation1b / GLDStation2a / GLDStation2b / Hospital1 / TipperStation* nodes) are not present in the Ignition tag tree where they should be mapped.
Do not proceed with configuration changes based only on this training segment; use deeper support procedures for tag provider/mapping configuration if needed.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: "SYS1 is where all metrics are converted to tags for Aveva to read." and "For OptiSweep to communicate we utilize tag provider and are mapped under Ignition." The slide also lists the mapped GLDStation* / Hospital1 / TipperStation* tag entries.

success_criteria: Ignition tag tree shows the mapped station/hospital namespaces from the source: GLDStation* (including GLDStation1b, GLDStation2a, GLDStation2b), Hospital1, and TipperStation* entries with the documented suffix naming.
The SYS1 → tags → AvevaTest mapping concept is reflected by the presence of the expected tags AvevaTest is expected to read under the Ignition mapping.
healthy_conditions: Expected GLDStation* / Hospital1 / TipperStation* namespaces are visible in the Ignition tag browser/tree.
Tags implied by SYS1 metric conversion for AvevaTest are present under the mapped namespaces.
failure_conditions: One or more expected mapped namespaces (GLDStation1b / GLDStation2a / GLDStation2b / Hospital1 / TipperStation* nodes) are missing from the Ignition tag tree where they should be mapped.
SYS1 → tags → AvevaTest mapping concept cannot be supported because the expected tags are not present under the Ignition mapping.
escalation_guidance: If expected mapped tag namespaces are missing or not present where the source indicates they should be mapped, stop and escalate to deeper tag provider/mapping configuration support procedures. Do not proceed with configuration changes based only on this segment.
